purpose: Public, privacy-safe lifecycle contract; never a recipient ledger
principles: An email draft is not an approved send
A sent message is not a delivered message
A delivery event is not a read or agreement
A reply is not consent to unrelated follow-ups
Different mailboxes retain distinct custody and access scopes
Superseded versions remain linked and auditable
No automation may promote its own claimed effect without independent evidence
privacy_boundary: Store real recipients, account IDs, thread IDs and bodies only in authorized private custody; publish schema and synthetic tests only
